links.comparator_used: Base (non-custom) LLMs without RAG, answering from training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Accuracy of answers to 100 questions based on the 2022 AAOS ACL guidelines, blindly rated by two fellowship-trained surgeons
links.effect: All noncustom models started below 60% accuracy; RAG improved every model by an average 39.7%; best RAG model was Llama3 70b at 94%
links.quote: Applying RAG improved the accuracy of every model by an average 39.7%.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) and agent augmentation of existing LLMs
